conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, if technological advancements or scientific discoveries capture widespread public interest and become common topics of conversation, they can certainly become part of pop culture. Their mainstream appeal and discussion are key factors.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Interestingly, the term "pop culture" itself became widely used in the mid-20th century, coinciding with the rise of mass media like television and radio. This allowed for cultural trends to spread more rapidly than ever before.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
